theme_label: Ukraine and Donbas before the full-scale war
definition: Events in and around Ukraine up to 2022-W07: FOM's standing rubric «События на Украине» and its variants, the Donbas conflict, Ukrainian politics and Zelensky, the 2021 and winter-2021/22 military build-up and fear of a Russia–Ukraine war, the Feb-2022 evacuation of DNR/LNR residents to Russia.

theme_label: Fighting in Ukraine and the war overall
label_ru: Ход СВО и боевые действия на Украине
definition: FOM's standing rubric on the war as a whole in every wording («Военная операция России на Украине» … «СВО в целом, успехи российской армии»), named battles, advances and retreats (cruiser Moskva, Kharkiv region, Kherson, Artemovsk/Bakhmut, the 2023 counteroffensive, Avdeevka, Ugledar), Russian strikes on Ukraine (incl. the Oreshnik strike on Yuzhmash), the Zaporizhzhia NPP and the Kakhovka dam, changes in the SVO command, war deaths, prisoners of war (abuse, executions, exchanges, the Azov commanders' return, the Il-76 crash carrying Ukrainian POWs) and war reporters killed at the front.

theme_label: Shelling and drone strikes on Russian territory
label_ru: Обстрелы и атаки дронов на территорию России
definition: Ukrainian shelling, missile and drone attacks, explosions and sabotage on Russian regions including Crimea: the Belgorod oil depot, Saki airfield and other blasts in Crimea, the Crimean bridge (Oct 2022, Jul 2023), the Sevastopol beach, drones on Moscow, Kazan and Taganrog; FOM's rubric «Обстрел(ы) российских территорий» in every wording and its 2023 rubric «Атаки дронов, взрывы (теракты, диверсии) на территории России».

theme_label: Kursk incursion and other ground raids into Russia
label_ru: Вторжения в приграничные регионы, Курская область
definition: Armed groups crossing from Ukraine into Russian regions and the fighting that follows: the Bryansk sabotage group (Mar 2023), the Belgorod raids (May 2023, Mar 2024), the Ukrainian incursion into Kursk region from Aug 2024 and the fighting there through 2025, including Russia's counter-offensive.
The September-2022 partial mobilisation, its end, fears of a second wave, the 2023 electronic-summons law, reservist training call-ups.

Russia's incorporation of territory and its anniversaries: Crimea Reunification Day and anniversaries (incl. the 2022 Luzhniki concert where Putin spoke), the Tavrida highway and 'events in Crimea' (2020), recognition of DNR/LNR, the Sept-2022 referendums, accession of four regions and martial law there, the accession anniversary.

theme_label: Western weapons and aid to Ukraine
definition: Western arms supplies and aid packages for Ukraine (Ramstein, US aid), the debate on and permission for long-range strikes into Russia with Western weapons, Macron's talk of sending NATO troops, the leaked German officers' Taurus talk, Zelensky's wartime US visits and Biden's visit to Kyiv.
Prigozhin's complaints about ammunition (May 2023), the June-2023 mutiny and his death in the August-2023 plane crash.
War-related stories that do not recur: missiles falling in Poland (2022), the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra dispute (2023), Russia leaving the grain deal (2023), Zelensky's statements (2024).

theme_label: Relations and talks with the US and the West
label_ru: Отношения и переговоры с США и Западом
definition: FOM's standing rubric on tense relations with the US, EU and NATO in every wording, including variants that append «санкции», arms supplies, NATO ships or drills; leader contacts and talks (Putin–Biden calls and the 2021 Geneva summit, Biden's 'killer' remark and Putin's reply, the Jan-2022 Russia–NATO–US security talks, the 2024 G7 and Swiss peace conference and talk of peace negotiations, the 2025 Putin–Trump call, the Riyadh talks, the Trump–Zelensky meeting and Russia–US contacts on a ceasefire); expulsions of diplomats; visits of Western politicians (Merkel, Nuland, Orban); Lavrov's meetings with Borrell and Blinken and his Carlson interview; NATO summits and OSCE meetings; military incidents with NATO near Russian borders (US and UK destroyers, US/NATO activity in the Black Sea, the US drone downed in 2023); the ICC warrant for Putin; prisoner swaps with the West (Bout 2022, Aug 2024).

theme_label: Western sanctions and exit of foreign companies
definition: Names led by sanctions against Russia: the 2022 waves, counter-sanctions, foreign companies leaving, partial lifting, the oil price cap (2022), US sanctions on the Moscow Exchange (2024).

theme_label: Nuclear threat, weapons tests and military exercises
definition: Russia's strategic military power and nuclear risk outside the front: missile and weapons tests (Tsirkon, Sarmat), the 2021 anti-satellite test, military exercises and 'strengthening defence capability', the New START treaty (extension 2021, suspension 2023), tactical nuclear weapons in Belarus, the 'dirty bomb' claims, Russian warships sent to Cuba, the threat of nuclear war and changes to the nuclear doctrine (incl. Putin's doctrine speech).

US domestic politics and US presidents as the subject: the 2020 racial unrest, the 2020 election and its aftermath, Biden's inauguration, the impeachment attempt, Biden's health, the 2022 midterms, the Texas border stand-off, the 2024 campaign (debates, the attempt on Trump, Biden's withdrawal), Trump's election, inauguration, statements and actions in 2025, Biden's Middle East trip (2022).

Wars and crises in the Middle East plus Afghanistan: the Jan-2020 US–Iran exchange of strikes incl. the Ukrainian airliner shot down over Tehran, Syria and Libya in 2020 incl. the Russia–Turkey friction over Idlib, Russian aid to Syria, the 2021 US strike on Syria, the 2021 Israel–Gaza fighting, the US withdrawal and Taliban takeover in Afghanistan (2021), the Hamas attack and the Gaza war 2023–25, strikes on Yemen, Iran–Israel clashes, the Lebanon pager blasts, Raisi's death, the fall of Assad and the Gaza ceasefire.

label_ru: Белоруссия и другие страны бывшего СССР
definition: Crises, elections and relations with Russia in ex-Soviet states other than Ukraine. Belarus: the 2020 election and protests, Russians (Wagner) detained in 2020, the 2021 forced landing of a plane, the 2021 migrant crisis on the Polish border, Putin–Lukashenko meetings, Lukashenko's statements, the 2025 election. Also the 2020 Karabakh war and Russian peacekeepers, the 2022–23 Karabakh flare-ups, Armenia's politics, unrest in Kyrgyzstan (2020) and Kazakhstan (Jan 2022, CSTO), Moldova's elections, Transnistria, Georgia's protests.

Multilateral summits and assemblies other than NATO, G7, EU and OSCE: BRICS, SCO, CSTO, CICA (Astana 2022), G20, the UN General Assembly (incl. Putin's 2020 speech), Russia–Africa; state visits both ways with China, India, North Korea, Iran, Turkey, the Gulf states and Vietnam; Putin's foreign trips named as such; Lavrov's trips to Africa, Latin America and elsewhere; Russia–China contacts.

Foreign stories that happen once and do not recur: Brexit, Hagia Sophia's status, the Suez Canal blockage, the Haiti president's murder, Abe's killing, Johnson's resignation, Pelosi in Taiwan, US bank failures, protests and riots in France, Macron and von der Leyen in Beijing, Turkey's elections and 'events in Turkey', the Niger coup, Xi–Biden talks, the attempt on Fico, the EU/UK/French elections, South Korea's martial law.

theme_label: Putin: speeches, trips, Direct Line and forums
label_ru: Путин: выступления, поездки, прямая линия, форумы
definition: FOM's standing rubric on Putin's meetings, trips, speeches, statements and actions in all its orderings, plus his set pieces: the Direct Line and big press conference, the Address to the Federal Assembly, SPIEF, the Eastern Economic Forum, Valdai, Russian Energy Week, the Tucker Carlson interview, his birthday, the New Year address, his visit to the SVO zone, his rest in Tuva.

theme_label: Elections, the 2020 constitution vote and the government
definition: How federal power is formed and run: the 2020 constitutional amendments from announcement to the July-2020 vote (incl. the Tereshkova term-reset amendment), September regional elections and single voting days, the 2021 Duma election, the 2024 presidential election from Putin's announcement to his inauguration; the federal government: the Jan-2020 resignation and Mishustin's appointment, Mishustin's illness and regional trips, Chubais's new post, the May-2024 cabinet (Shoigu replaced by Belousov); FOM's «Работа властных структур, ...» rows that append a concrete subject («Работа властных структур, подготовка к выборам», «Работа властных структур, перестановки во власти»).

theme_label: Corruption cases and arrests of officials
definition: FOM's 2020–21 corruption rubric (corruption, anti-corruption measures, arrests), the arrest of the Stavropol traffic-police chief (2021), the 2024 Defence Ministry scandals (deputy minister Ivanov and others).
Navalny's 2020 poisoning and its investigation, his Jan-2021 return and arrest, trial and the rallies in his support, prison, health and hunger strike, his death and funeral in 2024.

Street protests and unrest in Russia not tied to Navalny, and prosecutions of activists and journalists: governor Furgal's arrest and the 2020 Khabarovsk protests, the Kushtau protests, the July-2020 Moscow and St Petersburg rallies, the 'Network' (Set') trial, the 2020 arrests of journalists and activists, Slavina's self-immolation, Chechnya and Kadyrov in 2022 (the Yangulbaev case), the 2023 Makhachkala airport riot, the 2024 Baymak unrest in Bashkiria.

theme_label: Blocking of social networks and platforms
definition: Blocking or slowing of platforms: Instagram and other networks (2022), the YouTube slowdown and block and Discord (2024), and the detention of Telegram's founder Durov in France (2024).

One-off domestic political stories: MP Rashkin's illegal elk hunt (2021), the Supreme Court ruling that the LGBT movement is 'extremist' (2023), and FOM's leftover catch-all row «Другие события» («Другие события», 2023-W15, mixed quotes).

theme_label: Prices, inflation, the ruble and the key rate
definition: FOM's standing price rubric in every wording (prices, tariffs, utility tariffs, inflation, falling living standards), the ruble exchange rate (falls in 2020, 2022, 2023; the spring-2022 strengthening), shortages and panic buying (2020, 2022), price-control measures, Central Bank key-rate decisions and Nabiullina's reappointment, mortgage rates, 'the state of the economy', and the vague 2020 'social (and economic) problems' rows whose quotes are about prices, pensions and the ruble («Социальные проблемы россиян», «Социальные проблемы», «Социально-экономические проблемы»).

FOM's standing rubric on rises in pensions, wages, child and family benefits and the minimum wage in all its permutations; payments to vulnerable groups (incl. the 2020 COVID support payments named without COVID, «Выплаты, льготы социально незащищенным группам населения»); announced social-policy changes (maternity capital, «Предстоящие изменения в социальной политике»); indexation for working pensioners.

theme_label: Oil and gas: prices, exports, Nord Stream
label_ru: Нефть и газ: цены, экспорт, «Северный поток»
definition: The 2020 oil-price crash and the OPEC+ deal (incl. the stock-market fall named with it), TurkStream, the Nord Stream 2 saga (construction, the US–German deal), Europe's 2021 gas crisis, gas-for-rubles (2022), energy supplies to Europe, the 2022 Nord Stream explosions and the investigations into them incl. Hersh's (2023).

One-off economic and infrastructure stories: the tax on bank deposits and support for small business during the 2020 lockdown, the tourism cashback law, the timber export ban, factory openings, road development (2023).

theme_label: COVID-19: the epidemic, vaccines and restrictions
definition: Everything about the coronavirus in every wording: FOM's standing rubric (from «Эпидемия коронавируса в Китае» to «Рост заболеваемости коронавирусом»), case growth and new variants, Putin's COVID addresses, hospitals, payments to medics, Russian aid abroad, the Russian vaccine and the vaccination campaign, and the restrictions: the 2020 quarantine and non-working days and their lifting, flight halts, QR codes and mandatory vaccination, and the hardship and discontent restrictions caused.
Flu and ARVI outbreaks (winter 2020, December 2022), including school quarantines for flu.
Health news that does not recur, such as the problems of Russian healthcare (2020).

theme_label: Natural disasters and weather in Russia
definition: FOM's standing rubric «Природные катаклизмы в России» and its many seasonal variants (fires and floods, abnormal weather, natural anomalies, «Стихийные бедствия» with no place named), forest fires, Far East disasters, spring high water, the 2024 floods incl. the Orsk dam breach.

theme_label: Accidents, fires and man-made disasters in Russia
label_ru: Аварии, пожары, техногенные катастрофы в России
definition: FOM's standing accidents rubric in every wording (аварии, пожары, взрывы, ДТП, несчастные случаи, отравления детей) and named accidents in Russia: the Ryazan arms-depot blasts, household gas explosions, the Listvyazhnaya mine, the Yeysk plane crash, train and bus crashes, the Wildberries warehouse fire, the Nizhny Tagil and Makhachkala blasts; man-made ecological disasters (the Norilsk fuel spill and Kamchatka pollution in 2020, the Kerch Strait tanker wrecks and fuel-oil spill 2024–25); the 2024 heating and power outages; single accidental deaths (the Epiphany drowning, a child killed by stray dogs, the hospital fire in Blagoveshchensk).

label_ru: Катастрофы и стихийные бедствия за рубежом
definition: Natural and man-made disasters outside Russia: the Australian fires (2020), Turkish earthquakes (2020, and 2023 with Syria), the Beirut port blast, floods in Europe (2021) and Spain (2024), Turkish wildfires, volcanoes, the US hurricane, the California fires; plane crashes abroad (India, Indonesia, Turkey incl. a Russian plane, Kazakhstan 2024, Washington 2025), the Ohio chemical train, the Titan submersible.

FOM's standing crime rubric («Криминальные события», «Преступления, криминальные события», «Преступления, несчастные случаи(, аварии)») and named crimes and trials: actor Efremov's fatal crash and trial, the Sankin verdict, the Mytishchi shootout, the Moscow MFC shooting, metro fights and beatings, the Kostroma and Korkino murders, the 'ChVK Redan' teenage gang, hoax bomb threats against schools, the Wildberries office shooting, the Bishimbayev murder trial in Kazakhstan.

Armed attacks on schools, universities and kindergartens: the Kazan school (May 2021), Perm university (Sept 2021), FOM's 'shootings in educational institutions' row (Oct 2021), the Ulyanovsk-region kindergarten (2022), the Izhevsk school (Sept 2022, named «Трагедия в Ижевске»), the Bryansk gymnasium (2023).

Terrorist attacks and assassinations. In Russia: the killings of Dugina (2022), Tatarsky (2023), Kiva (2023) and General Kirillov (2024), the car bomb against an SVO veteran (2024), the Alye Parusa blast (2025), Crocus City Hall (2024), the Dagestan attacks and the Volgograd prison-colony hostage-taking (2024), FOM's «Взрывы, теракты в России» and «Теракты, криминальные события». Abroad: France and Austria (2020), Turkey (2022).
Odd one-off incidents that are neither accidents, crimes nor disasters: the shark attack on a tourist in Egypt (2023), a man rescued after drifting in the Sea of Okhotsk (2024).

FOM's standing holiday rubric («Праздники», «Праздники, памятные даты», «Годовщины, праздники, традиционные события/даты», «Праздники, культурные/зрелищные мероприятия», «Праздники, дни памяти/поминовения») and named holidays: New Year and Christmas, Navy Day and its parade, 8 March, extra days off, festivals and concerts, the 2024 World Youth Festival.

label_ru: День Победы и память о войне
definition: Victory Day celebrations and parades (incl. the 2020 postponement to 24 June and the Immortal Regiment), Holocaust and victims-of-fascism remembrance, the Rzhev memorial, the Armed Forces cathedral built for the 75th anniversary (2020), the 2024 trophy exhibition, disputes over WWII memory (Trump's 2020 remark, the Nazi veteran honoured in Canada's parliament in 2023).

FOM's standing sport rubric («Спортивные события», «События в области спорта»), the Olympics (Tokyo 2021, Beijing 2022, Paris 2024), the 2022 World Cup and Euro 2024, Russia's Games of the Future and BRICS Games (Kazan 2024).

Deaths of actors, entertainers, athletes, public figures and royals: Zhvanetsky, Maradona, Lanovoy, Prince Philip, Menshov, Zhirinovsky (incl. his illness and death rumours), Gorbachev, Elizabeth II, Shatunov, Zavorotnyuk, Maslyakov; also the emergencies minister Zinichev (2021).
Schooling and exams: distance learning in 2020–21, exams, school holidays, the start of the school year and the Day of Knowledge, the last bell, graduation.
Labour migrants in Russia as a public issue: 'the migrant problem', conflicts with migrants and crimes by migrants (2023–24, sharper after Crocus).
Space flights and missions: the 2020 US crewed launch, the 2021 film shot on the ISS, Luna-25 in 2023, and other launches.

label_ru: Другие события в обществе и культуре
definition: Cultural and social items that do not recur: Eurovision 2021, the 'Russia' expo at VDNKh, Ivleeva's 'naked party', Twix the cat.
